_comment: Anchor coordinates for well-known Varanasi venues, for use when building the location object in events.json. 'verified' entries were cross-checked against a primary source (Wikipedia infobox or a dedicated geocoding lookup) during skill authoring. 'approximate' entries are locality-level estimates (accurate to roughly a few hundred meters, fine for city-scale map pins but not for pinpoint navigation) — if a task genuinely needs tighter precision for one of these, search for a better fix rather than trusting the approximate value blindly. For any venue not listed here, search for its coordinates rather than guessing, and mark coordinate_precision accordingly (or leave lat/lng null with a note if nothing reliable turns up).
